mod.description: Hold sermons on any day and as often as you like (adjustable), optionally without Gratitude.
Enabled.name: Mod enabled
Enabled.description: Turns the mod on or off (takes effect immediately).
AnyDay.name: Sermons on any day
AnyDay.description: Allow sermons on every day of the week, not just on the Day of Wrath.
AnyDay.hint: Not just on the Day of Wrath.
CeremoniesPerDay.name: Sermons per day
CeremoniesPerDay.description: How many sermons are allowed per day (0 = unlimited). Unless "Ignore Gratitude" is on, every sermon still consumes Gratitude equal to the number of parishioners. That remains the natural limit.
CeremoniesPerDay.hint: 0 = unlimited. Gratitude is still consumed unless ignored.
IgnoreGratitude.name: Ignore Gratitude
IgnoreGratitude.description: Sermons no longer depend on Gratitude: the number of parishioners is set by church quality alone and no Gratitude is consumed. Takes effect the next time you open the prayer window.
IgnoreGratitude.hint: Parishioners = church quality, no Gratitude is consumed.
